target.observation_model: independent Gaussian with price SD c * half_spread

task.conditioning: complete ordered noisy prices / fixed half_spread; no additional channels
task.scope: fixed-design development experiment; no scientific acceptance

optimizer.interpretation: One-step weight-delta scaling at identical prestate/gradient/Adam slots; candidate optimizer and other arrays are retained. Float32 interpolation need not be bit-identical to rerunning Adam at the lower LR. No future trajectory equivalence is claimed.

restoration.variable_mapping: saved group/index/shape/dtype/hash; Keras constructor name counters and model-root prefixes can change on archive reload

scope: Eight local, discarded next-step perturbations; no stationary jitter, causal, data-sufficiency or acceptance claim.
candidate_other_state_scope: Native nontrainable, optimizer and metrics state with old trainables. Inference does not use optimizer/metrics; dropout is zero, so this measures normalization effects and any remaining inference-relevant nontrainable change.
